---
title: "SHAP Waypoint → Sequence Mapping (Contrastive)"
---

## 1. Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R", "paths.R"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

FIGURES_DIR   <- out_path("figures")
INTERMEDIATES <- out_path("sequence-classifier/intermediates")
BASE          <- out_path("sequence-classifier")

# How many top SHAP waypoints to display (must be <= TOP_K in shap_nearest_sequences.py)
TOP_K_DISPLAY <- 5

dir.create(FIGURES_DIR,   showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(INTERMEDIATES, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## 2. Load SHAP Ranking & Identify Top Waypoint Features

```{r load-shap-ranking}
shap_ranking <- read_csv(file.path(INTERMEDIATES, "shap_feature_ranking.csv"),
                         show_col_types = FALSE)

# Contrastive waypoint features with signed direction. The patient model uses mean activations
# only, so each waypoint appears once
wp_features <- shap_ranking %>%
  filter(str_detect(feature, "^CW\\d+_mean$")) %>%
  mutate(wp_index = as.integer(str_extract(feature, "\\d+")))

# Positive-direction waypoints: push toward MS, FDR-significant, ranked by significance
pos_wp <- wp_features %>%
  filter(signed_mean_shap > 0, fdr_p < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(fdr_p) %>%
  distinct(wp_index) %>%
  head(5) %>%
  pull(wp_index)

# Negative-direction waypoints: push toward Other, FDR-significant, ranked by significance
neg_wp <- wp_features %>%
  filter(signed_mean_shap < 0, fdr_p < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(fdr_p) %>%
  distinct(wp_index) %>%
  head(5) %>%
  pull(wp_index)

# Positive first then negative — order propagates to heatmap x-axis
top_wp_indices <- c(pos_wp, neg_wp)

cat("Positive-direction waypoints:", paste(pos_wp, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Negative-direction waypoints:", paste(neg_wp, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Combined order:", paste(top_wp_indices, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## 3. Load Pre-Computed Nearest Sequences

Pre-computed by `shap_nearest_sequences.py` (GPU).

```{r load-nearest-sequences}
nearest_seqs <- read_csv(
  file.path(INTERMEDIATES, "shap_nearest_training_sequences.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

cat("Loaded nearest sequences:", nrow(nearest_seqs), "rows\n")
cat("Waypoints in file:", paste(sort(unique(nearest_seqs$wp_index)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Sequences per waypoint:", nearest_seqs %>% count(wp_index) %>% pull(n) %>% unique(), "\n")

# Filter to the TOP_K_DISPLAY waypoints
nearest_seqs <- nearest_seqs %>%
  filter(wp_index %in% top_wp_indices)

cat("After TOP_K filter:", nrow(nearest_seqs), "rows across",
    n_distinct(nearest_seqs$wp_index), "waypoints\n")

# Truncate v_call to gene level (IGHV4-34*01 → IGHV4-34)
nearest_seqs <- nearest_seqs %>%
  mutate(v_gene_trunc = str_remove(v_call, "\\*.*"))
```

## 4. Rank Sequences Per Waypoint

```{r rank-sequences}
# Already ranked by distance (ascending) — rank 1 = closest to waypoint
# Create a convenience long-format tibble for downstream plots
top_seqs_per_wp <- nearest_seqs %>%
  mutate(
    wp_label = factor(paste0("CW", wp_index),
                      levels = paste0("CW", top_wp_indices))
  )

cat("Top sequences per waypoint:\n")
top_seqs_per_wp %>%
  count(wp_index) %>%
  print(n = 30)
```

## 5. V Gene Enrichment Per Waypoint

```{r vgene-enrichment}
# Background V gene frequencies from all training+test data
# The nearest_seqs file contains the top-N per waypoint; for background we need
# the full set. Use the weights CSVs.
train_meta <- read_csv(data_path("classifier/classifier_data_igblast-train-weights.csv"),
                       col_select = c("v_call"), show_col_types = FALSE)
test_meta  <- read_csv(data_path("classifier/classifier_data_igblast-test-weights.csv"),
                       col_select = c("v_call"), show_col_types = FALSE)
all_meta <- bind_rows(train_meta, test_meta) %>%
  mutate(v_gene_trunc = str_remove(v_call, "\\*.*"))

bg_vgene <- all_meta %>%
  count(v_gene_trunc, name = "bg_n") %>%
  mutate(bg_total = sum(bg_n))
rm(train_meta, test_meta, all_meta)

cat("Background V gene distribution:", nrow(bg_vgene), "genes,",
    first(bg_vgene$bg_total), "total sequences\n")

# Per-waypoint enrichment (Fisher's exact test, one-sided greater)
vgene_enrichment <- top_seqs_per_wp %>%
  group_by(wp_index) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    top_counts <- .x %>% count(v_gene_trunc, name = "top_n")
    top_total  <- nrow(.x)

    top_counts %>%
      left_join(bg_vgene, by = "v_gene_trunc") %>%
      mutate(
        bg_n     = replace_na(bg_n, 0L),
        bg_total = first(na.omit(bg_vgene$bg_total)),
        p_value  = map2_dbl(top_n, bg_n, ~ {
          fisher.test(
            matrix(c(.x, top_total - .x, .y, first(bg_vgene$bg_total) - .y), nrow = 2),
            alternative = "greater"
          )$p.value
        }),
        fold_enrichment = (top_n / top_total) / (bg_n / first(bg_vgene$bg_total))
      )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

cat("Significant enrichments (p_adj < 0.05):\n")
vgene_enrichment %>%
  filter(p_adj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(p_adj) %>%
  select(wp_index, v_gene_trunc, top_n, fold_enrichment, p_adj) %>%
  print(n = 50)
```

## 6. Plots

### 6a. Heatmap: Top Waypoints × Enriched V Genes

```{r heatmap-enrichment, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
# V genes with at least one significant enrichment
sig_vgenes <- vgene_enrichment %>%
  filter(wp_index %in% top_wp_indices, p_adj < 0.001, fold_enrichment > 2) %>%
  distinct(v_gene_trunc) %>%
  pull(v_gene_trunc)

if (length(sig_vgenes) == 0) {
  # Fallback: top enriched V genes by fold enrichment
  sig_vgenes <- vgene_enrichment %>%
    filter(wp_index %in% top_wp_indices) %>%
    group_by(v_gene_trunc) %>%
    summarize(max_fe = max(fold_enrichment, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    slice_max(max_fe, n = 10) %>%
    pull(v_gene_trunc)
}

heatmap_data <- vgene_enrichment %>%
  filter(wp_index %in% top_wp_indices, v_gene_trunc %in% sig_vgenes) %>%
  mutate(
    sig_label  = if_else(p_adj < 0.05, "*", ""),
    fe_display = if_else(is.infinite(fold_enrichment), NA_real_, fold_enrichment),
    wp_label   = factor(paste0("CW", wp_index),
                        levels = paste0("CW", top_wp_indices))
  )

p_heatmap <- ggplot(heatmap_data,
       aes(x = wp_label, y = v_gene_trunc, fill = fe_display)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 5, colour = "black", nudge_y = -0.4) + 
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name      = "Fold\nenrichment",
    na.value  = "grey80",
    option    = "D",
    direction = -1
  ) +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid  = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    x        = "SHAP-ranked contrastive waypoint",
    y        = "V gene",
    title    = "V gene enrichment among nearest sequences per waypoint"
  )
p_heatmap
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig4F_shap_waypoint_vgene_heatmap.svg"),
       p_heatmap, width = 3.75, height = 3)
```

## 7. Export Summary Tables

```{r export-tables}
write_csv(vgene_enrichment,
          file.path(INTERMEDIATES, "shap_waypoint_vgene_enrichment.csv"))
write_csv(top_seqs_per_wp,
          file.path(INTERMEDIATES, "shap_waypoint_top_sequences.csv"))

cat("Exported:\n")
cat("  - shap_waypoint_vgene_enrichment.csv:",
    nrow(vgene_enrichment), "rows\n")
cat("  - shap_waypoint_top_sequences.csv:",
    nrow(top_seqs_per_wp), "rows\n")
cat("\nInput CSVs (from shap_nearest_sequences.py):\n")
cat("  - shap_nearest_training_sequences.csv\n")
cat("\nTOP_K_DISPLAY:", TOP_K_DISPLAY, "waypoints shown\n")
```
